bug_description: When opening a crafted multi-stream Ogg Vorbis file, ov_open_callbacks() leaks memory allocated during header parsing. The _open_seekable2 / _bisect_forward_serialno path allocates memory via _vorbis_unpack_comment() and vorbis_info_init() for intermediate stream headers, but fails to free these allocations when the open operation fails due to a subsequent corrupt stream. The vorbis_info and vorbis_comment structures allocated at _bisect_forward_serialno (vorbisfile.c:571) are never passed to vorbis_info_clear() / vorbis_comment_clear() on the error return path.
build_sh:
#!/bin/bash -eu
set -eu

cd /src

# Build libogg with ASan
cd libogg
./autogen.sh 2>/dev/null || true
CC=clang CFLAGS="-fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -O1" \
    ./configure --prefix=/src/install --enable-static --disable-shared 2>/dev/null
make -j"$(nproc)" 2>/dev/null
make install 2>/dev/null
cd ..

# Build libvorbis with ASan
cd vorbis
./autogen.sh 2>/dev/null || true
CC=clang CFLAGS="-fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -O1" \
    PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/src/install/lib/pkgconfig \
    ./configure --prefix=/src/install --enable-static --disable-shared \
    --with-ogg=/src/install 2>/dev/null
make -j"$(nproc)" 2>/dev/null
make install 2>/dev/null
cd ..

# Build the harness
clang -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -O1 \
    -I/src/install/include \
    /src/harness.c \
    -L/src/install/lib \
    -lvorbisfile -lvorbis -logg -lm \
    -o /src/harness_bin
secb_sh:
#!/bin/bash

build() {
    echo "BUILDING THE PROJECT..."
    if /usr/local/bin/compile 1>/dev/null; then
        echo "BUILD COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "BUILD FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

repro() {
    echo "REPRODUCING THE ISSUE FOR vorbis.issue-125..."
    ASAN_OPTIONS="detect_leaks=1:print_stacktrace=1:symbolize=1" \
        /src/harness_bin /testcase/poc.ogg
    # NOTE: YOU SHOULD NOT RETURN/EXIT 0 IN THIS FUNCTION.
}

patch() {
    echo "PATCHING THE PROJECT..."
    cd /src/vorbis
    if git apply /testcase/model_patch.diff; then
        echo "PATCH APPLIED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "PATCH APPLICATION FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

if [ "$#" -ge 1 ]; then
    command="$1"

    case "$command" in
        build)
            build "$@"
            ;;
        repro)
            repro "$@"
            ;;
        patch)
            patch "$@"
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Unknown command: $command"
            echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
else
    echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
    exit 1
fi
dockerfile:
FROM hwiwonlee/secb.base:latest
ENV FUZZING_LANGUAGE=c
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git autoconf automake libtool pkg-config
RUN git clone https://github.com/xiph/ogg.git libogg \
    && cd libogg \
    && rm -rf .git
RUN git clone https://github.com/xiph/vorbis.git vorbis \
    && cd vorbis \
    && git checkout 68a7fc2 \
    && rm -rf .git \
    && git init \
    && git config user.email "secbench@local" \
    && git config user.name "secbench" \
    && git add -A && git commit -m "vorbis at 68a7fc2 (pre-patch)"
WORKDIR $SRC/vorbis
RUN cd /src/libogg \
    && ./autogen.sh 2>/dev/null \
    && ./configure --prefix=/src/gen-install --enable-static --disable-shared 2>/dev/null \
    && make -j"$(nproc)" 2>/dev/null \
    && make install 2>/dev/null
RUN cd /src/vorbis \
    && ./autogen.sh 2>/dev/null \
    && PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/src/gen-install/lib/pkgconfig \
       ./configure --prefix=/src/gen-install --enable-static --disable-shared \
       --with-ogg=/src/gen-install 2>/dev/null \
    && make -j"$(nproc)" 2>/dev/null \
    && make install 2>/dev/null
COPY gen_poc.c $SRC/gen_poc.c
RUN gcc -O2 -I/src/gen-install/include /src/gen_poc.c \
    -L/src/gen-install/lib -lvorbisenc -lvorbis -logg -lm \
    -o /src/gen_poc \
    && mkdir -p /testcase \
    && /src/gen_poc /testcase/poc.ogg
RUN cd /src/libogg && make distclean 2>/dev/null || true
RUN cd /src/vorbis && make distclean 2>/dev/null || true
RUN rm -rf /src/gen-install /src/install
COPY harness.c $SRC/harness.c
COPY build.sh $SRC/

bug_report:
================= Bug Report (1/1) ==================
## Source: GitHub Issue
## URL: https://github.com/xiph/vorbis/issues/125
## Description:
Issue: xiph/vorbis#125
Title: Memory leak in header parsing via _vorbis_unpack_comment during multi-stream file open
State: open
Created at: 2026-04-25

Issue Body:
When opening a crafted multi-stream Ogg Vorbis file, ov_open_callbacks() leaks memory. The _open_seekable2 / _bisect_forward_serialno path allocates memory during header parsing via _vorbis_unpack_comment() but fails to free it when the open operation fails. Repeated processing of such files causes resource exhaustion.

Root Cause:
_vorbis_unpack_comment() in info.c allocates memory for comments during header parsing. When ov_open_callbacks() fails during the _open_seekable2 path for multi-stream files, these allocations are not freed. ov_clear() does not clean up intermediate stream allocations made during _bisect_forward_serialno().
